title: Blue Shade Debts
style: clever indie pop, rhythmic delivery, witty lyrics, acoustic guitar and light percussion, upbeat but ironic mood, male vocals
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I told her I was blue, she thought I meant the shade
But I was drowning in the debts that haven't yet been paid
I said I'm feeling fine, she thought that I was great
But I'm just paying off the tickets for the laws I break
I’m looking for a sign, she points towards the street
But I'm just searching for a miracle to find my feet

[Chorus]
It’s a play on words, a stage for every sound
Building up the meaning just to watch it hit the ground
Double-edged delivery, a sharp and clever tongue
Songs that tell a story while the double truth is swung
Yeah, it’s all just wordplay, dancing on the line
Between what I am saying and what you think you find

[Verse 2]
I said I need some space, she booked a flight to Mars
But I was staring at the vacuum left behind by scars
I told her life is bright, she went to grab the shade
But I was blinded by the light of every choice I made
She said I'm acting cold, and brought a heavy coat
But I was shivering from words that got stuck in my throat

[Chorus]
It’s a play on words, a stage for every sound
Building up the meaning just to watch it hit the ground
Double-edged delivery, a sharp and clever tongue
Songs that tell a story while the double truth is swung
Yeah, it’s all just wordplay, dancing on the line
Between what I am saying and what you think you find

[Bridge]
A pun is just a pistol if you aim it at the heart
A sentence is a prison if you don't know where to start
I’m reading between lines that were never even there
Catching every double meaning floating in the air

[Guitar Solo]

[Chorus]
It’s a play on words, a stage for every sound
Building up the meaning just to watch it hit the ground
Double-edged delivery, a sharp and clever tongue
Songs that tell a story while the double truth is swung
Yeah, it’s all just wordplay, dancing on the line
Between what I am saying and what you think you find

[Outro]
I’m literal, I’m lyrical, I’m lost within the text
Waiting for the period to tell me what is next.
(Fade out)
[End]
